subject: Allura Vysoren
fact_text: Matt says Arcanist Allura Vysoren asked the party to find Lady Kima of Vord. Allura and Kima were longtime friends.

subject: Grog Strongjaw
fact_text: Grog's uncle Kevdak banished him from the herd. Pike healed Grog and the two remained close friends.

subject: Vex'ahlia
fact_text: Vex'ahlia and Vax'ildan are twins. Their father was an ambassador in Syngorn. Vex's bear companion was Trinket.

subject: Lady Kima
fact_text: Matt recounts that the group found Lady Kima in a torture chamber beneath Emberhold. Kima and Clarota had formed a tense alliance.
